rationale: Price has collapsed from the session high of $30.79 to $29.99, sitting at only 12% of today's range and hugging the 9-EMA, with the last five 1-minute candles showing extremely tight, low-volume consolidation ($29.99–$30.03) — no directional momentum in either direction.
